notes: Three routes («ح» before the third) all meet at Ubayd Allah or Qasim, but the text writes the names for each: separate groups, null tail

«وعن نافع، عن ابن عمر» is a second route from Ubayd Allah's own report (the mid-chain «وعن» takes its head from the sentence before), and carries the same saying; «حوحدثني» is the taḥwīl written without a space
The saying («إن بلالا يؤذن بليل ...») is given in the third route only; the first two end at «أن رسول الله ... قال»
